'''Staguu Itincoovar''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] who lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Although he had been taken from [[Youngling/Legends|infancy]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Itincoovar failed his [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Initiate Trials]], and no [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] elected to take him as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. However, he was integrated in the Order's [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] at the request of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ekim Ryelli]]. During the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Itincoovar accompanied Ryelli and [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] to [[Nicht Ka]], where an ancient structure had been discovered. While the Givin was sent back to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in order to compare some [[Writing/Legends|inscriptions]] with the ship's database, Cillmam'n discovered an ancient [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that once belonged to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warb Null]]. While researching the philology database, Itincoovar received a transmission from [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, announcing that the Clone Wars had been won and that all Jedi were ordered to return to their [[Jedi Temple/Legends|main temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWI" />

When the Givin tried to communicate with Master Ryelli via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], no answer came. Unbeknownst to Itincoovar, Cillmam'n had put on Warb Null's armor, fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and [[Duel on Nicht Ka|beheaded]] Master Ryelli. The Givin himself was also [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the murderous Cillmam'n&mdash;who now referred to himself as "Malleus"&mdash;returned to the ship.<ref name="SWI" />
